<div class="masonry-gallery">

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

image_files <- list.files("images/amazon", full.names = TRUE)

for (img in image_files) {
  cat(sprintf('![](%s){group="gallery" loading="lazy"}\n\n', img))
}
```

</div>

<style>

.masonry-gallery {
  column-count: 3;
  column-gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.masonry-gallery p {
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.masonry-gallery a {
  display: block;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.masonry-gallery img {
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  break-inside: avoid;
}

.gallery-img {
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: block;
  break-inside: avoid;
}

/* One column on mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .masonry-gallery {
    column-count: 1;
  }
}

</style>
